Table cell-F1 moved from 0.858 to 0.936, precision from 0.808 to 0.896, recall from 0.958 to 0.997, and TEDS-approx from 0.669 to 0.893. The dominant issue was over-detection: boxed prose/cards, sparse ruled regions, and repeated page furniture were being emitted as tables, while real tables often included title or note rows that damaged structure scoring. The fix tightens candidate acceptance, trims sparse title/furniture rows, and rejects prose-like borderless grids without changing the scorer.
